rationale: Micah's work on visual intuition for machine learning systems and graph data visualization directly complements Ming's zkVM architecture and verifiable computing infrastructure — both are building the foundational layers that make complex AI and cryptographic systems legible to humans and systems. Ming's expertise in Rust-based proof systems and universal computation pairs well with Micah's track record shipping interactive ML tooling (H2O.ai) and his conviction that beautiful data products unlock AI's true potential, creating a natural technical and philosophical alignment around making advanced systems intelligible and usable.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Ming Guo — you're both architecting the invisible foundations of decentralized AI (zkVM proofs and visual ML intuition), and your skill stacks on verifiable compute + interactive visualization could unlock a novel interface for understanding cryptographic systems at scale.
